instruction: Fix `safe_write` in `fileops/write.py` so writing to an existing file replaces its contents. It currently appends instead of truncating, so a second write leaves the old content in place.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/fileops/write.py b/fileops/write.py
--- a/fileops/write.py
+++ b/fileops/write.py
@@ -6,7 +6,7 @@
 def safe_write(path, content):
     """Write ``content`` to ``path``, creating missing parent directories first."""
     ensure_parent(path)
-    with open_text(path, "a", newline="\n") as handle:
+    with open_text(path, "w", newline="\n") as handle:
         handle.write(content)
     return str(path)
